blocks.html: My motivation for learning trajectory optimization started with trying to figure out how high my robot leg can jump, given its physical limits. At first, I thought some machine learning algorithm could come in handy, like the ones you see on YouTube. However, those proved too complicated for my simple use-case. I only needed to optimize a 2 DOF robot leg. That's when I discovered Trajectory Optimization. The essence of trajectory optimization is pretty straightforward, you optimize over a trajectory with a given objective function. However, in the real world, you have to account for physical limits as well.

To account for these physical limits, many trajectory optimization problems use non-linear programming as solvers.
